skill.summary: This skill helps users discover key contacts across industries, roles, and social platforms via the BrowserAct API. Agent should proactively apply this skill...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Industry Key Contact Radar API skill.
- Enables discovery of key contacts by industry, job title, and platform using the BrowserAct API.
- Automates extraction of public profile URLs, names, introductions, and company details.
- Handles API key configuration, error messages, and retry logic for common issues.
- Provides flexible parameter options for customized searches across multiple use cases.
